subject: [NAME] - 3D Assets
text:
Hi [NAME],

I noticed [COMPANY] Showcase is leaning into immersive experiences for buyers
- how is your team handling ML workflows around 3D assets and spatial
understanding?

At Encord, we enable multimodal workflows where 3D floorplans, point
clouds, and text annotations live in a single interface.

We've recently expanded this into a dedicated point-cloud offering for
teams tackling spatial-reasoning challenges.

Would you be open to learning more?

subject: Rahul - ML Pipelines
text:
Hi [NAME],

I'm Adi [SENDER] - a Series B YC-backed startup helping 200+ teams build
AI models faster and more easily.

When speaking with fraud prevention leaders, we often hear that in-house
data management tools are limited primarily to annotation.

With Encord's advanced Data Curation, we help IDV teams improve model
accuracy by enabling better data collection and exploration through
embedding and cluster-based search.

I'd love to explore how we could solve similar challenges for Socure -
would you be open to learning more?

subject: Tailored Platform Walkthrough
text:
Hi [NAME] - hope you enjoyed the product tour.

I'd love to walk you through the Encord platform in a workflow tailored to
your existing/ upcoming project(s) at [COMPANY].

We're familiar supporting human data service from working with Invisible
Technologies and Sapien - happy to also cover how partnering would look
like.

How's Thursday afternoon looking for a quick chat?

subject: Optimising model development - Encord invite
text:
Hey [NAME],

I hope you're doing well and have had a good start to [YEAR].

I've been chatting with Mateusz Wozny about your processes for preparing data for model training at Asseco. We were supposed to have a meeting this afternoon, but he recommended that I reach out to you.

My team at Encord has been working with companies like Augmundo and Standard AI, helping them to develop their models more effectively. These teams move over to our platform when they start facing bottlenecks in between their data collection and model training.

They do this, because our platform offers multimodal data annotation and curation, flexible workflows and ontologies, and dashboards that allow you to really optimise your teams productivity.

I'd love to grab 20 mins of your time to discuss your current data pipelines, and show you what our platform can do. I'm therefore very presumptively going to drop you a calendar invite for this Thursday - please change that however you like. Alternatively, feel free to book directly into my calendar here.

subject: Virtual Coffee - road/ driver safety
text:
Hi [NAME],

I met Mengliao Wang at the Ray Summit - it sounds like building
vision-based model for AI Dashcam is a key focus for your team, much like
our customer Motive. So I wanted to reach out for a virtual coffee.

For context - Motive leverages Encord to standardize video data operation
processes. On Encord, technical teams can curate datasets from million
miles of driving videos send to be annotated in the same platform, and
program managers have clearer understanding over label quality and
workforce productivity.

Keen to hear where you see [COMPANY]'s data preparation workflow to be
improved. Would you be open to a virtual coffee afternoon times tomorrow?

subject: Audio and Video annotation + VLA/VLMs
text:
Hi [NAME],

I've spoken with several people on your team about doing more with audio
and video annotation, and exploring VLA/VLM workflows.

We're working with peers like Nexar and Motive to scale multimodal data
pipelines and manage large internal annotation teams, including native
audio and video annotation (no frame-splitting or CVAT-style workarounds).

Motive recently moved ~400 internal annotators onto Encord as a strategic
decision, and I think the rationale would be directly relevant to what
you're building.

Do you have time to connect this Thursday afternoon (PT)? I'm wide open.

subject: Procore - catch up
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope your [YEAR] is off to a good start! I've been following your work
scaling Procore's AI platform and Construction Cloud - really impressive.

I'm speaking with heads of data/AI building enterprise AI platforms in
construction, where data is inherently multimodal - site images, video,
drawings/PDFs, and sensor/time series data. At Encord, we work with teams
in construction and robotics to streamline multimodal workflows (curation,
annotation, evaluation). I'd love to get your perspective on how you
approach data quality, feedback loops, and governance at scale.

Would you have 20 minutes next week for a quick virtual coffee to compare
notes? I'm flexible Tue to Thu mornings PT but happy to work around your
schedule.

subject: [NAME] - reconnect in [YEAR]
text:
Hi [NAME],

Believe you spoke with [SENDER] and [SENDER] back in [YEAR], I was wondering if the
year is a good time to reconnect to explore the potential migration from
CVAT.

I believe the main concern earlier was the internal effort required to
migrate platforms - since then we've tripled our engineering team and built
capacity to support teams through a much smoother migration process.
Our leadership team was very keen to work with you given the strong fit for
surgical video - we'd be really excited to revisit the opportunity and
(hopefully) start working together in [YEAR],
Let me know your thoughts, Best wishes, [SENDER] *AI // ML // Computer Vision*
